## [1.3.0](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/compare/v1.2.1...v1.3.0) (2026-11-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Disable Reels:** Keep the Reels tab scrollable with Stop scrolling on ([6fc3983](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/6fc3983e2c2c351e126fdd8f9252fe8e11593a72))
* **Liquid Glass navigation bar:** Keep the reel comment box above the navigation bar ([65d607d](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/65d607d6417c1cf057e5b21334c65f2422501e49))
* **YouTube Music:** Keep the full player's glass whole and steady ([89414e1](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/89414e1c438b3a1fb692c41e77f8531e213c3744))
* **YouTube Music:** Start the tab lens on Home after a cold start ([5bf34c4](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/5bf34c4bbd9f852b8cfd9167e266ed526b7ea2ae))

### ✨ New Features

* **Liquid Glass navigation bar:** Frosted header on Home and Explore ([f825ac6](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/f825ac68b5db35c2ca6d3685f88f04490e233f25))
* **Liquid Glass navigation bar:** Glass share menu, glass header buttons and tilt light ([37542c8](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/37542c8d234e6e357aa4a3d46c7629ebf348c40f))
* **Spotify:** Liquid Glass navigation bar and mini player ([9963b4a](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/9963b4ac5a579b33dab4c45bc29f5aa1d6b35589))
* **YouTube Music:** Dock the mini player beside the tab bar ([9c6043f](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/9c6043fe6bb37875b19417e042389b31d3990aef))
* **YouTube Music:** Liquid Glass navigation bar and mini player ([3f0cccc](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/3f0cccc4b3f5fc920f6e9364008992616afa612b))
* **YouTube Music:** Liquid glass on the full player ([a606c1c](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/a606c1ce040701e4af2e19975ed7a429fca86680))
* **YouTube Music:** Stop the build without Morphe's GmsCore support ([94421de](https://github.com/southstar21dev/southstar21-patches/commit/94421defad0d9baf9ff1d420152765fad28583c6))

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar into floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass with live background blur and edge refraction, with the mini player docked beside it as round album art with a progress ring, a glass playback bar above, and the content scrolling on behind them. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill. Requires Morphe Patches with GmsCore support, applied together in Expert mode.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Thicker glass, and a press swells the selection into a magnifying drop of glass that wobbles and stretches as you drag it.

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Stops Instagram rejecting apps by their signature, which a patched app no longer matches.

patches.name: Conscious gate
patches.description: Gives the home feed, Reels, Explore and stories a daily time budget. In the last 15 seconds they frost over and can only be scrolled, then a gate closes them until the next day. Searching for people, messages and profiles keep working. Off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Disable Reels
patches.description: Removes reels from the home feed and Explore, and stops scrolling from one reel to the next. Each part is off until you switch it on in the settings.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts, stories and reels, and ad units in the home feed. Each part can be switched off in the settings.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Adds settings to hide Search, Reels, Create, Messages and other tabs from the bottom bar. Every tab stays until you hide it in the settings.

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar into a floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass pill with live background blur and edge refraction. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Lets feeds scroll underneath the bar so there is something to see through the glass. Turn off if the last item of a list ends up hidden.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.

patches.name: View profile picture
patches.description: Adds a button on the profile picture of profile pages that shows the profile picture in full resolution and saves it to the gallery.

patches.name: Liquid Glass navigation bar
patches.description: Turns the bottom tab bar and the mini player above it into floating iOS 26 style Liquid Glass with live background blur and edge refraction, and colors the selected tab Spotify green. Refraction needs Android 13+, blur needs Android 12+, older versions get a tinted pill.

options.description: Blur applied to content behind the bar, in dp.
How strongly the glass edge bends the content behind it, from 0 to 100.
Thicker glass, and a press swells the selection into a magnifying drop of glass that wobbles and stretches as you drag it.
